snippet.title: Backpack Alchemist - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Backpack Alchemist - Official Trailer

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4534730/Backpack_Alchemist_Medieval_Shop_Simulator

Join our Community on Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/BackpackAlchemist/

Follow us on x: https://x.com/gummygames_ofc

Manage your own cozy medieval alchemy shop! Pack your limited leather backpack with rare potions, odd ingredients, and magical relics. Solve satisfying grid-based inventory puzzles to fulfill customer orders and become the realm's greatest alchemist.

Developed by Gummy Games.
#BackpackAlchemist #IndieGame #Gaming #GummyGames
